zh.name: VIVIAN WANG
zh.role: 化妆总监 | VIVIAN ADVENTURE 创始人
zh.bio:
资深影视与时尚，专注中英及国际项目：
• 英国电影电视剧造型总监
• 加拿大电影服化道总执行
• 尚美巴黎（Chaumet）高珠晚宴、时装周秀场及明星红毯特邀合作造型总监
• 服务领域：电影制作、短剧、综艺、广告、时尚、婚礼定制、高端定制、明星同款旅拍

en.name: Vivian Wang
en.role: Makeup Director | Founder of VIVIAN ADVENTURE
en.bio:
Experienced in film & fashion across UK–China projects:
• Styling Director (UK film & TV)
• Executive Head of Costume & Makeup (Canadian films)
• Invited lead for Chaumet high jewelry gala & fashion weeks
• Services: film, short dramas, variety, commercials, fashion, wedding couture, bespoke travel shoots

zh.name: Hao
zh.bio:
专注时尚与艺人肖像光影塑造，注重层次与质感的稳定输出。
流程：前期面部/材质观察 → 光比规划 → 现场微调与回看。
风格：稳健光比、克制修饰、定制化方案。

en.name: Hao
en.bio:
Fashion & artist portrait light shaping with consistent tonal depth.
Workflow: facial/material scan → ratio plan → live micro‑adjust & review.
Style: controlled ratios, restrained retouch, tailored planning.

zh.name: Jade
zh.bio:
电影与时尚影像创作，擅长情绪光影与人物表达。
特点：叙事张力、镜头节奏感、技术与美学平衡。

en.name: Jade
en.bio:
Film & fashion visual creator; strong at mood lighting and character expression.
Traits: narrative tension, rhythmic framing, craft–aesthetic balance.

zh.name: Patrick Xue
zh.role: 摄影师｜影像艺术创作者
zh.bio:
结合传统与实验媒介，探索材质与情绪的影像表达。
擅长：胶片/即时成像、叙事型 MV、材质肌理营造。

en.name: Patrick Xue
en.bio:
Blends traditional & experimental media to explore texture and mood.
Strengths: film & instant formats, narrative MV, material tactility.

zh.name: Kris
zh.bio:
以富士色彩与自然光构建呼吸感人像氛围。
擅长：自然街拍、克制细节、色温渐变。

en.name: Kris
en.bio:
Uses Fujifilm color & natural light for airy, restrained portraits.
Strengths: candid urban sessions, subtle detail, gentle temperature shifts.

zh.name: Fu
zh.bio:
专注色彩与情绪的平衡，塑造带时间质感的光影。
特点：留白控制、光影层次、真实情绪捕捉。

en.name: Fu
en.bio:
Balances color & emotion, shaping time‑layered light.
Traits: managed negative space, layered illumination, authentic mood capture.

zh.name: Lori
zh.role: 化妆师｜造型与发型设计
zh.bio:
擅长韩妆体系与亚裔五官优化，注重提高面部骨相与比例关系。
定制化妆发方案：依据肤质与场景匹配底妆质地与发型结构；整体风格克制清爽、细节干净，审美统一。
适用：婚礼、时尚拍摄、商务形象。

en.name: Lori
en.bio:
Specialized in Korean‑inspired makeup for Asian faces, enhancing facial structure and proportions.
Customized makeup & hair plans matched to skin type and setting; clean, restrained finish with consistent aesthetics.
Suited for bridal, fashion shoots and business portraits.

zh.name: Johnny
zh.bio:
定制化男士发型与妆容，包含裸妆与上镜自然妆效，适用于商务、人像、活动等多场景。
根据骨骼与发流做自然过渡与轮廓修整；同时长期服务于艺人/明星造型。

en.name: Johnny
en.bio:
Customized men's hair and grooming, including natural/no‑makeup camera‑ready looks for business, portrait and event scenarios.
Aligns style to facial structure and hair flow; works as a celebrity stylist.

zh.name: Ivy
zh.role: 摄影与妆造助理｜客户与档期协调
zh.bio:
摄影方面擅长氛围感塑造，熟悉 Canon 系统与高清人像拍摄；依据人物特征安排合适光影并打造不同风格（清透、质感、纪实等）。
现场与幕后管理：跟进镜头顺序与补光设备、基础补妆与耗材补给、节奏与沟通维护；整理客户反馈以便后续优化。

en.name: Ivy
en.role: Photo & Styling Assistant | Client & Scheduling Coordinator
en.bio:
Strong at atmospheric photography; experienced with Canon systems and high‑definition portraits. Crafts light and shadow to suit each subject and can deliver varied styles (clean, textured, documentary).
On‑set & back‑of‑house: tracks shot order & lighting hand‑offs, light touch‑ups and consumables, pacing & comms; maintains client feedback for follow‑ups.
